answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as a digital dawn for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to stake collateral to validate blocks. This economic bridge forces attackers to acquire massive capital, turning a potential gale of fake identities into a prohibitively expensive venture. Because control scales with capital rather than node count, an adversary must absorb the entire cost of the network's stake to subvert integrity, effectively neutralizing the utility of generating countless autonomous replicas.
